chunks: As for everything in it narrated from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb, I have transmitted it from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥasan—may Allah be pleased with him—from al-Ḥasan ibn Muttayl, from Muḥammad ibn al-Ḥusayn ibn Abī al-Khaṭṭāb, from Jaʿfar ibn Bashīr, from Ḥammād ibn ʿUthmān, from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb ibn Maytham al-Asadī.
And he was a mawlā, a Kufan.

key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I transmitted it; a chain-linking expression used by the compiler.
key_terms.كُوفِيٌّ: A person from Kufah; a regional biographical identifier.
key_terms.مَوْلًى: A mawlā; a client or freed servant affiliation in biographical usage.

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb in Man Lā Yaḥḍuruhu al-Faqīh. It is a chain-clarification notice and concludes with a brief biographical identification of Yaʿqūb ibn Shuʿayb as a mawlā from Kufah.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Everything in this book that is narrated from Yaqub ibn Shuayb has been transmitted by me from Muhammad ibn Al-Hasan - may Allah (swt) be pleased with him - from Al-Hasan ibn Matil, from Muhammad ibn Al-Husayn ibn Abi Al-Khattab, from Jafar ibn Bashir, from Hammad ibn Uthman, from Yaqub ibn Shuayb ibn Maytham Al-Asadi,
who was a freed servant (mawla) and a Kufan.
